## Flagship Systems & Production Architectures

### 1. PichiTV — Ultimate Entertainment Hub
- **Type**: Native Android TV Leanback & Mobile IPTV Streaming Engine
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/PichiTv
- **APK Download**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/PichiPie_Tv_Apk-Only
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Android TV Leanback SDK, Google Media3 ExoPlayer, HLS/M3U8 Adaptive Bitrate, MVI Architecture
- **Key Features**: 1,500+ live satellite channels, 6 live sports hubs (EPL, UCL, CricHD, Willow, SonyLiv), 25,000+ movie vault, 0ms in-session instant caching, 60fps lazy pagination tuned for budget 1GB/2GB TV sticks.

### 2. PichiTube — Lightweight & Privacy-Focused YouTube Client
- **Type**: Native Android Video Streaming Engine
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/PichiTube
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture + MVI, Room SQLite, SponsorBlock API, MergingMediaSource
- **Key Features**: 100% ad-free playback, SponsorBlock auto-skip, Ultra HD 4K (2160p) audio/video multiplexing, background audio playback with lock-screen media notification controls, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), zero telemetry with 100% offline local SQLite storage.

### 3. Modern E-Commerce & Inventory Management Platform
- **Type**: Production Full-Stack Web Application
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/E-Commerce-Website
- **Tech Stack**: React 19 / React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL, Row Level Security (RLS), Vite
- **Key Features**: Multi-variant SKU management with automated PostgreSQL default triggers, RLS security policies, customer cart and checkout pipelines, live inventory stock telemetry.

### 4. SuperStore Enterprise Sales Analytics & Forecasting
- **Type**: Executive Business Intelligence & Time-Series Suite
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/SuperStore-Sales-Data
- **Tech Stack**: Microsoft Power BI, 24+ Custom DAX Measures, Star Schema Architecture, Excel
- **Key Features**: Deep modeling of 5,902 transaction records, Year-over-Year (YoY) revenue velocity, regional margin analysis, time-series forecasting, return rate anomaly detection dials.

### 5. Music Store Relational Database Analytics
- **Type**: Complex PostgreSQL Relational Analytics
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/mohammad-rabius-sani/Music-Store-Data-Analysis
- **Tech Stack**: PostgreSQL, Complex SQL, Recursive CTEs, Window Ranking Functions (DENSE_RANK)
- **Key Features**: 11 structured relational queries across a normalized 3NF schema, track-to-album revenue contribution pipelines, customer lifetime value modeling.
